speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I asked for the pipeline to catch regressions before they hit the morning order window, not just to log them. If we wait for a manual trigger, a bad model will starve the distribution centres of accurate replenishment data for a full night.
output.correction: I am not talking about the weekly retraining cycle. I need the shadow deployment to run on every single model commit so we can validate the forecast accuracy before it touches the store manager app.
